objective: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

description: Take the cleansed orb back to Menara in Ratchet, <name>. Give her my regards and be safe. I truly hope you are able to withstand the temptation and corruption that is sure to come as you follow your path.
progress: How goes your search for Tabetha and the orb, <name>?
Tabetha has been more than useful when it comes to matters of the arcane. I'm sure she would have no problem aiding you if you're able to find her.
completion: Well done, <name>. This will do nicely.
The only thing left for you to do is to decide on which demon you want me to imprison within the cleansed orb. Do that, and you will have a magnificent new item to wield.
